description.value:
Worthless trash.
Better carry some with you.

"Some say that in the deep retreats of the cosmos, an invisible portal will open to those carrying a piece of junk."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, a creature can consume or administer this item. The target loses hit points equal to its proficiency bonus. This cannot reduce it below 1 hit point.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, immediately causes a single ally to lose HP equal to 15% of their Max HP.
